name: chegou
description: Phone ↔ PC file transfer from the terminal. Run npx chegou, scan the QR, done.
readme_summary: Chegou is a command-line tool that enables seamless file transfer between a PC and a phone over a local network or via a Cloudflare tunnel. It requires no phone installation and operates with a simple QR code scan.
key_features: Send and receive files, photos, videos, text, and links between PC and phone
Operates over local network (LAN) or via Cloudflare tunnel for cross-network access
No phone app installation required, disposable connection
Secure transfer with a token-based QR code
File dropping directly onto the terminal window
Optional features like auto-shutdown timeout and automatic folder opening
primary_use_case: Quick and easy file sharing between a computer and a mobile device without the need for external apps or cloud services, primarily for local network transfers.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, stylized robot hand extending from a computer monitor, holding a glowing QR code. From a smartphone held by an unseen person, a stream of colorful digital icons (photos, documents, links) flows directly into the monitor through the QR code. The background is a clean, minimalist workspace with subtle network lines connecting the devices. The overall mood is efficient and magical, emphasizing the 'it just works' aspect of instant, wireless transfer. The repository name 'chegou' is subtly integrated into a digital display on the monitor. Style: 3D isometric illustration, vibrant colors, clean lines, soft lighting.

name: ember-p2p
description: A social network with no servers
readme_summary: Ember is a decentralized social network built on peer-to-peer technology, eliminating the need for central servers, accounts, or algorithms. It uses a keypair for identity and relies on users re-sharing content to keep it alive, with discovery based on topic proximity rather than popularity.
key_features: Discovery via locality-sensitive hashing (LSH) and topic rooms
primary_use_case: To provide a decentralized, censorship-resistant social networking platform where users control their data and interactions without relying on central servers or algorithms.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, bustling marketplace where people are exchanging glowing, ethereal scrolls of information directly with each other, bypassing any central stalls or authority figures. Each scroll has a unique symbol representing a topic. When three or more people gather around a specific scroll, a small, warm campfire of light ignites between them, symbolizing a live chat. Subtle digital particles and faint code snippets float in the background, hinting at the underlying technology. The overall mood is one of organic connection and shared knowledge. The repository name 'Ember' is subtly integrated into a signpost in the background. Rendered in a warm, inviting digital painting style with clear outlines and a focus on human connection.

name: ProxyBridge
description: Proxifier Alternative to redirect any Windows/MacOS/Linux TCP and UDP traffic to HTTP/Socks5 proxy
readme_summary: ProxyBridge is a universal proxy client for Windows, macOS, and Linux that acts as a Proxifier alternative. It enables transparent routing of TCP and UDP traffic from applications through SOCKS5 or HTTP proxies, allowing granular control over traffic flow on a per-application basis.
key_features: Transparent proxy routing for TCP and UDP traffic
System-level operation, compatible with proxy-unaware applications
Cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, and Linux
primary_use_case: To transparently route application network traffic through HTTP or SOCKS5 proxies on Windows, macOS, and Linux, offering an alternative to existing proxifier tools.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, transparent bridge arching over a digital river of data packets. On one side of the bridge, applications are shown as small, distinct buildings. On the other side, a secure proxy server is depicted as a fortified castle. Data packets flow from the application buildings, are seamlessly rerouted across the bridge, and then directed towards the proxy castle. Subtle glowing lines indicate the rerouting path. The ProxyBridge logo is subtly integrated into the bridge's structure. The overall aesthetic is clean, modern, and conceptual, using a color palette of blues, greens, and subtle metallic accents, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style.

name: phoneinfoga
description: Information gathering framework for phone numbers
readme_summary: PhoneInfoga is an advanced Go-based framework for gathering information about phone numbers. It collects basic details like country, carrier, and line type, and then uses various OSINT techniques, external APIs, and search engines to find potential VoIP providers or identify owners. It also offers a REST API and Go modules for programmatic use.
key_features: Gather basic information (country, line type, carrier)
OSINT footprinting using external APIs, phone books & search engines
Check for reputation reports, social media, disposable numbers
primary_use_case: Information gathering and OSINT investigation on phone numbers.
cover_image_prompt: A digital detective, wearing a trench coat and holding a magnifying glass made of glowing data streams, examines a floating phone number. Around the phone number, various icons representing social media profiles, search engine results, and database entries materialize like puzzle pieces. The detective's screen shows a simplified UI with the phone number being analyzed and a 'Reputation Score' indicator. The background is a stylized, abstract network of connections. The overall mood is one of focused investigation and discovery. The art style should be a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with a cool color palette emphasizing blues and purples, with subtle glowing elements.

name: Understand-Anything
description: Graphs that teach > graphs that impress. Turn any code into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and ask questions about. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
readme_summary: Understand Anything transforms codebases into interactive knowledge graphs, allowing developers to explore, search, and understand complex projects more effectively. It integrates with various AI coding assistants to provide a visual overview of code structure and dependencies.
key_features: Interactive knowledge graph visualization of codebases
Exploration, search, and querying of code structure
Integration with AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI, etc.)
Visual dashboard for understanding code relationships
primary_use_case: To help developers quickly understand and navigate large or unfamiliar codebases by visualizing them as interactive knowledge graphs.
cover_image_prompt: A wise old librarian meticulously organizing an infinitely sprawling library where each book represents a file in a codebase. The librarian uses a glowing magnifying glass to reveal intricate connections and relationships between the books, forming a complex, interconnected web. Small, subtle digital particles representing code flow through the aisles. In the background, faint outlines of AI assistants are seen helping the librarian. The scene is bathed in warm, inviting light, emphasizing clarity and understanding. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, organized aesthetic, featuring the repository name 'Understand Anything' subtly etched on a library cart.

name: midday
description: Invoicing, Time tracking, File reconciliation, Storage, Financial Overview & your own Assistant made for Freelancers
readme_summary: Midday is an AI-powered business assistant for freelancers and solo entrepreneurs, consolidating invoicing, time tracking, file storage, and financial overview into a single platform. It aims to streamline business operations by automating tasks like invoice matching and providing insightful financial analysis.
primary_use_case: To provide freelancers and solo entrepreneurs with an integrated platform for managing all aspects of their business operations, from tracking time and sending invoices to storing documents and analyzing finances.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic AI assistant, depicted as a wise owl wearing a small tie, perched on a stack of organized financial documents. The owl is using a magnifying glass to meticulously sort and match incoming digital receipts (represented by glowing paper slips) to outgoing invoices (represented by sleek, modern digital cards). Around the owl, a secure vault icon glows, holding important contracts, and a stopwatch icon indicates active time tracking. Subtle UI elements of the Midday dashboard are visible on a floating holographic screen. The scene is set in a clean, modern home office bathed in warm, productive light, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on clarity and organization.
